3d.description: 3D web experience — Three.js, React Three Fiber, Spline, WebGL, interactive 3D scenes, product configurators

game.description: Phát triển game HTML5 — support 2D (Phaser), 3D (Three.js), Isometric. Load orchestrator + workflow.
game.template: Load `.opencode/skills/game-development/SKILL.md` → route đến đúng sub-skill theo platform/dimension. Sau đó chạy `.opencode/workflows/game.workflow.md`.

ui-ux.description: UI/UX design — web (React/Tailwind), game HUD, CLI output

preview.description: Start game live preview dev server (Vite HMR + browser auto-open)
preview.template: Load `.opencode/skills/games-preview/SKILL.md`. Then run: `npm run dev` (hoặc `npx vite --open --host` nếu chưa có script).

compile.description: Prompt Compiler — phân tích intent, extract constraints, sinh IR, tối ưu prompt cho LLM backend. Zero AI, zero token.
compile.template: Load `.opencode/skills/prompt-compiler/SKILL.md`. Input → Pipeline 14 stages → IR → Backend prompt.

init.description: Khởi tạo project mới với scaffold wizard

status.description: Xem trạng thái session, memory, pipeline

feedback.description: Gửi feedback về session hiện tại
feedback.template: Chạy: `node .opencode/runtime/bin/vibe.mjs feedback` — nhập nội dung feedback

resume.template: Chạy: `node .opencode/runtime/bin/vibe.mjs resume` — kiểm tra pipeline state và tiếp tục

validate.description: Kiểm tra engine contracts, pipeline, router integrity

pipeline.description: Quản lý pipeline: trạng thái, start, pass/fail phase, watch live

diff.description: Xem diff changes và rollback file

secret.description: Quản lý secrets: set/get/delete/list API keys, tokens

detect.description: Tự động phát hiện project type, framework, language

context.description: Xem và quản lý session context (recent prompts)

enforce.description: ENFORCEMENT GATE: tự động validate + pipeline + context + detect. BẮT BUỘC trước mỗi phase.
enforce.template:
Chạy: `node .opencode/runtime/bin/enforce.mjs [run|pass|fail|phase] [phase_name]`

IRON LAW:
- `enforce run <phase>` — PRE-hooks: validate contracts, inject context, start pipeline, detect project
- `enforce pass <phase>` — POST-hooks: pipeline pass, context update
- `enforce fail <phase>` — POST-hooks: pipeline fail, context update
- Nếu enforce run FAILED → KHÔNG proceed. Fix lỗi trước.
- Skip enforce = violation.
